messages:
Kai: Quick FYI — my friend is swinging by at 3pm with a pet tortoise (yes 😂) in a large ventilated crate. Needs a temporary visitor badge and a quiet spot near plants if possible. Also a courier is dropping two boxes labelled 'board-game-prototype' around the same time :turtle: :package:
Front Desk: Noted. Can you confirm full name and phone so we can pre-print a badge? We have the lobby bench by the plant shelf free. Badge printer is on A desk — might need refeed paper today.
Kai: Name is Rohan Patel, phone 555-0199. Crate will be a bit slow to move so they might arrive ~3:10. No food or smell, tortoise is pretty chill.
Anya: I can refeed badge paper at 2:45. Is the crate small enough to fit by the bench or should we reserve the quiet side table?
Oliver: If the courier boxes are big, can we ask them to leave packages with reception? I can grab them and stash under the shelving. Courier-Bot: Incoming delivery alert at 15:02 for 2 packages addressed to "R&D Prototypes". Size: medium x2, handling: fragile. ETA updated at 15:01.
Front Desk: Perfect — we'll leave the bench clear, temp badge label will be printed with:
```
Visitor: Rohan Patel
Company: Guest
Badge: TEMP-ROHAN-3PM
Notes: Tortoise, needs quiet space near plant shelf
```
Front Desk: Also tagging the crate with a laminated sticker and placing a small mat under it in case of drips.
Maya: Who wants to volunteer to be the tortoise wrangler escort? Need someone to walk them from lobby to bench slowly :eyes:
Kai: I can meet them in lobby and help inside. If anyone's allergic to reptiles please shout now (I think tortoise is low-allergen).
Anya: No allergies here, happy to help with the badge handoff.
Oliver: I'll collect the courier boxes and leave a note on the crate so Rohan knows which is theirs.
Kai: Thanks all — tagging @Front Desk and @Courier-Bot again for visibility. If the badge printer jams, please ping me and I'll bring spare labels. :thumbsup:
